data: First Jupiter orbiter; 8 years of measurements
Skeleton entry for /fleet (PRD-012 v0.2 / Phase A scaffold). Builder + agency + first-flight per public sources. Specs and gallery TBD in later phases.

The first Jupiter orbiter (1995–2003), and the only mission to drop a probe into Jupiter’s atmosphere. Also discovered evidence for a subsurface ocean on Europa — making it one of the most consequential planetary missions ever flown.
First spacecraft to orbit Jupiter; atmospheric probe into Jupiter clouds
NASA Discovery polar orbiter — neutron-spectrometer hydrogen finding at both poles 1998; deliberate Shoemaker impact ended mission 1999
Only spacecraft to visit all four giant planets
Longest-lived Mars asset ever — orbiting since 2001-10-24. Gamma-ray + neutron water-ice maps; UHF relay for the surface fleet
Companion orbiter to Viking-1 lander — relay + 50000 surface images at 150-300 m/pixel, the first global Mars map. Operated 1976-1980
